_note: EXAMPLE ONLY: the shape and the provenance discipline, not anyone's real numbers. scripts/build-history.mjs refuses --yes while "_example" is true. Copy this file to ~/.config/backlink-audit/history-series.json (or pass --series / set BACKLINK_AUDIT_SERIES), replace the points with your own derived dataset, and delete the "_example" key.
_provenance: Every point is DERIVED from a record you can re-run, never estimated.

Authored third-party threads: `gh search issues --include-prs --author <your-login>` and `--commenter <your-login>`; keep only threads whose comment body holds a live link to your target; date each thread by its FIRST link-bearing comment (created_at from `gh api repos/<r>/issues/<n>/comments`). One thread = one linking page, however many comments it has.
Links from your own repos to your site: `git log -S "<your-domain>"` in the linking repo gives the date the link first went live.
Skill-registry or package-registry listings: date each by the listing's creation date, and say in the note that you assumed the README link was present from publish.
cumulative is the running count of distinct linking pages on or after that date. It can go DOWN when a page drops the link; record the drop, do not hide it.
